Browser apps that include alternative browser engines must use the instruction set for all executables, including the extensions, in order to use the system’s pointer-authentication protection on devices that support it.
Build your browser app as a universal binary that also supports the instruction set to target iPad models that support alternative browser engines and don’t support instructions.
To configure your Xcode targets to use the instruction set: Select the Xcode project in the Project Navigator.

Alternatively, if you use Xcode configuration files to manage build settings for your targets, add this line to your configuration file: Don’t build your target with the instruction set for Simulator destinations.
If your Xcode workspace includes Swift Packages as dependencies for your targets, use workspace settings to build the packages using the instruction set.
